content: {"reasoning":"The payer returned PR-204 (service not covered under the plan), a patient-responsibility denial, and eligibility has lapsed—this is a coverage/benefit issue, not a coding, authorization, or medical-necessity dispute. No prior auth is required, retro-auth and P2P are unavailable, and there is no CO-16 info request, so appeals or resubmissions would be improper and just add costly touches. Since the PR prefix assigns the balance to the patient, the correct next step is to bill the patient.","action":"bill_patient"}
